history.value: Two-turn search (--two-turn) uses the fallback player, max nodes 400k and sample k 4 (four sampled next-turn hands), ~1.4-1.6 GB per thread; plain, it rebuilds about four trees per turn and costs about 115-140x one-turn per cell gauntlet sequence. The play mode for two-turn reads and the product since 2026-11-03 is --line-seed --step-line: one sample seed per combat turn (the committed-line player) and each uncut tree's principal line (sts.search(...)['line']) played without re-searching; the same decisions as the committed-line player at ~0.55-0.70 of the cost. A control played without those flags needs --vary line_seed --vary step_line under --against. --one-turn-floors 3 plays floors 1-3 one turn deep (screens only).
